2 in 1 - V-Rally 3 + Stuntman.name: 2 in 1: V-Rally 3 + Stuntman
2 in 1 - V-Rally 3 + Stuntman.summary:
2 in 1: V-Rally 3 + Stuntman is a compilation of games developed by Velez & Dubail and published by Atari Europe for the Game Boy Advance.

The game contains two full games, both developed by Velez & Dubail on a single cartridge.

M&M's - Blast!.name: M&M's Blast!
M&M's - Blast!.summary: M&M's Blast! for Game Boy Advance reunites players with those lovable candy-coated M&M characters--Red, Blue, Green, and Yellow--in a brand-new adventure. Players complete a number of game challenges within a variety of board-game-style levels.

Onmyou Taisenki - Zeroshiki.name: Onmyou Taisenki: Zeroshiki
Onmyou Taisenki - Zeroshiki.summary: Onmyou Taisenki: Zeroshiki is a Role-Playing game, developed by Kamui and published by Bandai, which was released in Japan in 2004.

RoboCop.name: RoboCop
RoboCop.summary: Game Boy Advance port of RoboCop.

Shingata Medarot - Kabuto Version.name: Shingata Medarot: Kabuto Version
Shingata Medarot - Kabuto Version.summary: Shingata Medarot is a remake of the first Medarot and was the last game in the series until its DS entry years later. Its art style is a huge departure from its predecessors'.
